html: So my latest novel, DEAD SHIFT, continues to be banned in China … the only one of my books to have been banished there. Ah well … Jack Gregory has apparently ticked off Chinese sensibility, even in fiction. To be fair, Jack does have a way of doing that.

comments.author: thelastbesthope
comments.html:
The Central Politburo of the Communist Party of China didn’t like it one bit. You had the Ripper off China’s best warrior/killer and Jack wasn’t even at full speed.
